title: Privacy-Preserving Deep Joint Source-Channel Coding with In-Loop Concept Erasure
abstract: arXiv:2609.13393v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep joint source-channel coding (DeepJSCC) transmits learned semantic features efficiently but can leak sensitive attributes such as gender, race, or speaker identity. We propose LEAPSC (LEACE-in-the-loop privacy for semantic communication), whose core contribution is the integration of in-loop least-squares concept erasure (LEACE) within a variational information bottleneck (VIB) encoder. By periodically refitting the projection operator during training, LEAPSC couples the encoder dynamics to the erasure mechanism, driving attribute-conditional mean differences toward zero within each task-label group on the fitting sample. Additional components, namely conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) tail-sensitive privacy, feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM) signal-to-noise ratio conditioning, and Lagrangian dual ascent, improve robustness across channel conditions and over the high-leakage tail of samples. On CelebA, FairFace, and Google Speech

translated_title: 基于环内概念擦除的隐私保护深度联合信源信道编码
translated_abstract: 深度联合信源信道编码（DeepJSCC）能够高效传输学习到的语义特征，但可能会泄露性别、种族或说话人身份等敏感属性。我们提出了LEAPSC（面向语义通信的环内LEACE隐私保护方法），其核心贡献是将环内最小二乘概念擦除（LEACE）集成到变分信息瓶颈（VIB）编码器中。通过在训练过程中周期性地重新拟合投影算子，LEAPSC将编码器的动态与擦除机制相耦合，使拟合样本上每个任务标签组内的属性条件均值差异趋于零。其他组件，包括条件风险价值（CVaR）尾部敏感隐私、特征级线性调制（FiLM）信噪比条件化以及拉格朗日对偶上升，提升了方法在跨信道条件以及样本高泄露尾部的鲁棒性。在CelebA、FairFace和Google Speech数据集上（原文摘要此处不完整）
tldr: 提出LEAPSC框架，将环内最小二乘概念擦除（LEACE）集成到变分信息瓶颈编码器中，实现防止性别、种族等敏感属性泄露且在信道条件和高泄露尾部均保持鲁棒的隐私保护深度联合信源信道编码。
en_tdlr: Proposes LEAPSC, a privacy-preserving DeepJSCC framework that integrates in-loop LEACE concept erasure within a variational information bottleneck encoder, preventing leakage of sensitive attributes such as gender and race while remaining robust across channel conditions and high-leakage tail samples.
